content: Hi, how can I support your content project today?
I need to write a short SMS to announce our spring sale to customers. Can you help me get started?

Absolutely. For a promotional SMS, I suggest we keep it concise and engaging. Key elements to include: a clear announcement of the sale, a timeframe, and a motivating call-to-action. These help customers quickly understand the offer and encourage them to visit your store.
Here's my draft: "Spring Sale! 20% off all items. Visit us soon." Is that okay?

That's a solid start. To enhance it, I recommend specifying the dates for clarity, and adding a friendly note to make it more inviting. For instance, mentioning 'limited time' creates urgency, while a warm closing encourages engagement.
Can you show me how that would look?

Certainly! Here's a refined version:

"Spring Sale: Enjoy 20% off all items this week only! Stop by and refresh your favorites, offer ends Sunday. We look forward to seeing you!"
That's great. Can you make it even shorter, but still friendly?

Of course! Here's a more concise version:

"Spring Sale! 20% off all items, this week only. Drop in and say hi!"
